notes: During major combat Congress funds the war it authorised: the daily running cost of the force is covered in full (plus a small margin) every day, so burn never outruns appropriations early on. The monthly O&M lump, the allotment cut and get-well plans start once major combat ends

Deploy to an AO is back on the AO screen and on every AO card. Every ground unit, whether sent to an AO or straight to a base in Iraq, lands at Camp Doha first and then drives north to where it was assigned

New Patrols tab on each AO: Balanced (patrol where the threat is), Focus cities (set how many companies patrol each city every day) or Dispersed presence (rotate through every town, road and approach in range)
